title: All the Vehicles official server
description: the official minecraft server for the all the vehicles modpack
body:
# All the Vehicles Server
The official minecraft server for the _All the Vehicles_ modpack. Feel free to build massive roads and highways

# Rules
1. No Griefing
2. Be respectful (No swearing in chat, no making rude comments about other players' builds, etc.)

Required Modpack: [All The Vehicles](https://modrinth.com/project/all-the-vehicles)

This server is running a flat world

# Features
## Vehicles
This server has vehicles like planes and cars.

## Signs
There are a lot of signs you can use, like stop signs, yield signs and a whole bunch of others.

## More Concrete
The more concrete mod allows for concrete slabs.
So now you can make easy slopes with road markings.
